text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
BURSA

- Trading in securities other than shares could revive the Bucharest stock exchange, which is well prepared for trading in state, municipal and corporate bonds, says bourse general manager Stere Farmache in an interview.
ROMANIA LIBERA
- The Carbid Fox chemical plant has joined in stock exchange trading starting Thursday.
- The Mobilrom consortium signed a GSM licence contract with the Communications Ministry.
- Romanian farmers managed to put an additional 32,000 hectares under wheat thanks to fine weather this month.
ADEVARUL

- Tractor maker Tractorul UTB SA in Transylvanian city of Brasov is expected to raise the wholesale and retail prices of tractors following rises in the prices of raw materials and the depreciation of the leu currency.
- The wheat the state purchased from farmers is enough to meet consumption needs till next March.

- Could the new government recover what the outgoing government has lost? the newspaper wonders, showing that funds for Romania blocked by the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank amount to $400 million.
- Short-term governing programme puts 1997 inflation at 35 percent. It says the gross domestic product is to rise by up to 5.0 percent.
TINERETUL LIBER
- The National Mineral Resources Agency got bids for oil blocs from eight foreign companies.
AZI
- Romania and Bulgaria signed a protocol in Sofia on the building of two new bridged across the river Danube.
CRONICA ROMANA
- Italian businessman Silvio Berrlusconi is interested in investing in a private television in Romania, the newspaper quotes television people as saying.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- Poul Thomsen, IMF chief negotiator for Romania, arroved in Bucharest on Wednesday to meet the country's new president, the central bank governor and the new finance minister.
- The leu's rate against the mark on the interbank market and at retail currency shops has appreciated slightly over the past week.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA
- The Romanian army must upgrade its equipment and ensure decent conditions for conscripts, the newspaper says.
ADEVARUL
- The newspaper publishes list of leading members in the standing commissions of the upper house, the Senate.
JURNALUL NATIONAL
- The two houses of parliament are expected to meet in a joint session next Tuesday to approve both cabinet list and programme of Prime Minister-designate Victor Ciobea.
CURIERUL NATIONAL
- The newspaper publishes list of MPs heading the standing commissions in the lower Chamber of Deputies.
- The National Unity Party might replace its leader, Gheorghe Funar, the paper says.
ZIUA

- The newspaper publishes draft of governing accord to be signed by the Democratic Convention (CDR), the Social Democratic Union (USD) and the Hungarian Democratic Union (UDMR) in a ceremony attended by President Emil Constantinescu on Friday.
- The National Peasant Party (PNT-CD), main party in the CDR bloc, will receive 12 portfolios in the new government, the USD six and the National Liberal Party another six.
CRONICA ROMANA
- The CDR bloc is to elect a new leader after Emil Constantinescu was elected President in November. ($=3,612 lei) -- Bucharest Newqsroom 40-1 3120264
